new_task_1.title: Hide lowercase NCZarr internal attributes when reading Zarr metadata
new_task_1.description: The upgrade makes xarray's Zarr backend treat `_nc`-prefixed metadata keys as internal netCDF/NCZarr bookkeeping regardless of case. Lowercase keys such as `_ncproperties` are no longer surfaced through dataset or variable attributes when opening Zarr-backed data.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure xarray does not expose NCZarr internal metadata as user attributes merely because the backend stored those metadata keys with lowercase `_nc` prefixes instead of uppercase `_NC`.

expectation.grounded: When xarray reads attributes from Zarr objects and Zarr groups, it must hide keys whose names begin with `_nc` in a case-insensitive way rather than only filtering uppercase `_NC` names. This filtering must apply alongside the existing hidden dimension metadata handling and must preserve all non-internal attribute keys unchanged.
expectation.conceptual: Users opening NCZarr-produced Zarr stores should see only application metadata, not backend bookkeeping attributes, regardless of whether the producing library wrote those internal keys in uppercase or lowercase form.

constraints.grounded: Do not change how ordinary attribute names are exposed unless their names begin with `_nc` under case-insensitive comparison. Existing hiding of the configured dimension metadata key must continue to work, and previously filtered uppercase `_NC*` attributes must remain hidden.
constraints.conceptual: This should be a compatibility fix for metadata visibility, not a broader change to Zarr attribute semantics.

behavior: Zarr attribute filtering now treats `_nc` prefixes case-insensitively when deciding which internal NCZarr metadata keys to hide.
Lowercase internal attributes such as `_ncproperties` or similar `_nc*` bookkeeping keys are no longer exposed through xarray-visible attributes.
Uppercase `_NC*` internal attributes continue to be hidden as before.
User-defined attributes whose names do not start with `_nc` under case-insensitive comparison continue to be returned unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: When xarray opens a Zarr or NCZarr store containing lowercase `_nc*` metadata keys, those keys should not appear in the resulting dataset or variable attributes.
When the same store contains uppercase `_NC*` metadata keys, those keys should continue to remain hidden.
When a store contains ordinary non-internal attribute keys, those attributes should still be exposed after the upgrade.
When xarray reads dimension metadata from the Zarr store, the existing hidden-dimension-key behavior should remain unchanged.
